🐱 Play MeowTrail

Light up all the white cells without letting bulbs see each other in this cat-themed Akari puzzle!

💡 How to play: Click a white cell to place a light bulb. All white cells must be lit by at least one bulb. No two bulbs may shine on each other. Numbered black cells tell you how many bulbs must be placed next to them.
